scope: one synthetic three-requirement CV and five labelled semantic cases; no production database or deployment
initialOutcome: failed: writer added unsupported quality/outcome/purpose clauses; assessor flagged them
codeChange: packages/ai/src/cv-prompts.ts: require clause-level grounding; prohibit inferred purposes/outcomes/quality and advert commentary

visualReview.findings: All text readable; no visible clipping or overlap; section hierarchy and page number intact. Large blank area reflects deliberately sparse evidence, not a layout-fill requirement.

textualReview.findings: Summary combines only the sourced role title and three evidence clauses. All three bullets restate supplied facts; no unsupported additions found.

costBasis: Provider-reported token usage multiplied by repository prices; no invoice reconciliation. Both runs retained.
limitations: Prompt hardening is not deterministic prevention of unsupported claims.
The same model extracts, writes and assesses; separate agent review was therefore performed.
Sparse single-role evidence does not cover long/multi-role CVs, complex qualification histories, prompt injection or repeated-run reliability.
No hosted end-to-end build, production account configuration or release deployment was verified.
